Name: Zap
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8). Each time the damage dice increase, you can modify the results of your damage type's roll by an additional ±1.

Special Notes.instruction: Replace this marker with the table whose id matches table_id when rendering the spell.
